recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if MnM or CDS decides that `species` needs a separate conditional additional binding in addition to the existing UsageContext.value[x] example binding.
issue_request: FHIR-13090 was a Published/Persuasive MnM change request for the DSTU2 datatypes page asking that the UsageContext context type code `species` have a value set, with the resolution to define an example binding to the same value set used for SDC.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-13090. The relevant source was already in place before final resolution: FHIR-12904 added the `species` usage-context-type code and the SNOMED species include, and FHIR-13059/#13059 added the UsageContextValue example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/use-context.
additional_context: UsageContext is active and normative in source/fhir.ini. Current source binds UsageContext.code to UsageContextType, binds UsageContext.value[x] by example to UsageContextValue, and defines UsageContextValue as http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/use-context. That value set still includes SNOMED CT descendants of 387961004. Later additional conditional bindings for some context-type codes do not make a separate species binding necessary to satisfy this issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active datatype and terminology source already contains the requested example value set coverage for species.
